description.narrative: The VU project team was overwhelmed by the experiences during our partner identification trip to Tanzania in april 2024. The enthusiasm expressed by the young members of TYC was inspiring, and we felt highly motivated to establish a sustainable partnership with this group, whose democratic values align with ours. The executive board and young volunteers of TYC expressed their vision of creating stronger ties between them and mental health work. The executive board of TYC expressed their vision of creating stronger ties between them mental health projects. More specifically, the young people wanted to improve youth conditions and spread awareness of mental health struggles. Based on this discussion, we wish to conduct a preparatory study in Tanzania. The purpose of the trip is to strengthen our partnership and jointly work on the application and preparations for the pilot project. The proposed project is to establish a mentorship programme that mentors young people and children in sensitive situations in the society, with the purpose of giving them resources and competences to be part of the civil society.
